subject: general
question: The weights (in kg) of 9 members of a school cricket team are 50, 63, x, 62, 64, 48, 51, 55, 48. If the mean weight is 56 kg, then the value of x is ________.
solution:
**Given:**

Weights of 9 members of a school cricket team: 50 kg, 63 kg, x kg, 62 kg, 64 kg, 48 kg, 51 kg, 55 kg, 48 kg

Mean weight = 56 kg

**Formula Used:**

Mean = (Sum of all weights) / (Number of members)

**Calculation:**

Number of members = 9

The sum of the given weights (including x) **S** = 50 + 63 + x + 62 + 64 + 48 + 51 + 55 + 48

Mean = S / 9

⇒ 56 = (50 + 63 + x + 62 + 64 + 48 + 51 + 55 + 48)/9

⇒ 56 × 9 = 441 + x

⇒ 504 = 441 + x

⇒ x = 504 - 441

⇒ x = 63

**The value of x is 63 kg.**
